source: Seconds per test, from the list reporter's durations in quality-pr job logs. Each is the mean of its tests there. 'conditions' and the rest: #84's run 39952674962 (job 120410772674, the cells with 11-2's rows) and #89's run 39941643227 (job 120374899100, the perf cells). 'pack' (#20): the tier sentinels, fallback complete on each fixture-* tuple, in runs 40005559234 (jobs 120592517614, 120592517646, 120592517916), 40056077145 (jobs 120759333022, 120759333077, 120759333129) and 40055662895 (jobs 120757997966, 120757997993, 120757998006): nine cells, 203.0 s a cell. 'composition': each composition's complete cell on its published default appearance (kinetic-cosmos, obsidian-atelier, spatial-bento), in run 40066815817 (jobs 120792219276, 120792219294, 120792219316, 120792219322): three cells, about 150 s a cell. 'sweep' (lib/sweep.ts): a swept pack's one test, its four rows on one page, local, scaled to CI by the stable sentinel in the same run: graphite and editorial-serif on each of the four compositions, eight tests at 12.11 s locally, beside the stable tier sentinel at 43.2 s locally in the rows the sweep runs (default, forced-colors, reduced-motion, reduced-transparency at 1440x900), which 'pack' has at 85.0 s in CI, so 12.11 × 85.0 / 43.2 = 23.8 s. 2a's first CI run replaces it. lib/pr-shards.ts reads it.

release.source: The release plan's weights (rc-quality, lib/full-shards.ts's releaseDurations): each key's p90 in seconds from the list reporter's durations of run 42161420147 (rc-preflight of 1dc6bf162), the 48 preflight-quality shards that ran (10,720 passed and 1,052 failed cell tests timed; skipped ones cost nothing), plus 5.2 s a test, the median over those shards of (the shard's span x 2 workers - its tests' seconds) / its timed tests: server starts, setup, a worker idle at the end. A key is '<viewport> <row>', 'pack' for a cell off the platform's default language, scheme or typography, 'conditions' for any other, as testWeight() keys a full-plan test. The high-contrast rows skip on every RUN_ENGINES.full engine (a unit holds them to it), so none is measured and they keep the PR weights. 'perf' is the perf tests' p90 (11 timed) plus the same 5.2 s.
